feature: Bank operation interpretation and conservative online category fallback
operation_policy: ATM PARA CEKME -> withdrawal hint and Tarik tunai suggestion; deposits ATM YATAN/YURTICI ATM P.Y./ATM PARA YATIRMA -> Setor tunai suggestion.
Non-POS Havale/EFT/FAST/Virman -> Transfer suggestion. Person names are not classified independently of the banking channel.
Transfer-channel BSMV Tahsilati or Komisyon(u) Tahsilati suffix identifies a service fee before generic transfer interpretation.
New negative fee rows are expenses; incoming fees remain unreviewed. ATM and bank-transfer rows retain signed unreviewed cash flows.
PREPAID IADE/IADESI uses Cashback per user convention, but unresolved credits are suggestions and do not confirm income.
SANAL POS ALISVERIS uses Belanja online only if no specific merchant or personal rule matches, including ambiguous merchant suggestions.
POS merchant names and FAST FOOD text are not bank-transfer evidence. Plain POS does not gain the online fallback.
preservation: No automatic cash-wallet choice, counter-leg creation, transfer pairing, or classification of historical financial types.
Original fingerprint normalization is unchanged; hardcoded historical fingerprint goldens and reimport deduplication pass.
Bank facts, signed amounts, IDs, dates and existing categories remain unchanged by category preview/application.
Immutable linked descriptions outrank editable notes; blank source descriptions do not fall through to edited-note operation guesses.
Operation hints appear in import preview, transaction history, category review and edit forms.
v2-to-v3 settings adoption adds only the new bank pack and four labels. Prior deleted/edited confirmed defaults are not replayed or restored.
v3 marker preserves later deletions, case-variant labels, export/import, and manual rule modes. Explicit default additions do not relabel existing personal choices.
Count/byte/quota/concurrency refusals preserve original settings and existing financial data.

user_sample.scope: Previously supplied backup and workbook evaluated read-only; original fingerprints and file hashes verified.

limits: Transfer destination and cash ownership still require user review; a recipient name does not supply a valid counterpart wallet.
Old ATM/transfer records already classified as expenses are not silently repaired; category review changes annotations only.
Cashback is a user-defined category convention; unresolved incoming financial types remain unreviewed.
Chromium on Windows and mobile emulation were verified; physical devices and manual screen readers were not tested.
Full performance, backfill and source-lifecycle suites were not repeated as whole suites; targeted storage/source cases and original regressions passed.
CI configuration includes this gate; remote CI was not executed.
packaging: New combined ZIP and off-PC backup deferred by user; old snapshots retained.
